data.title: Don't Let Rebate Paperwork Cost You Thousands: Townsend Helps Massachusetts Homeowners Get "Townsend Ready" for Winter
data.description:
Don't Let Rebate Paperwork Cost You Thousands: Townsend Helps Massachusetts Homeowners Get "Townsend Ready" for Winter

Don't Let Rebate Paperwork Cost You Thousands: Townsend Helps Massachusetts Homeowners Get "Townsend Ready" for Winter

PR Newswire

DANVERS, Mass., Sept. 26, 2026

Townsend's dedicated rebate specialist manages the entire paperwork process, helping customers access up to $8,500 in Mass Save rebates

DANVERS, Mass., Sept. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For some Massachusetts homeowners, an aging heating system may not make it through the winter. Nobody wants to replace a furnace or boiler when it's 10 degrees outside, so it's best to plan now, before the winter cold hits. Townsend says this is exactly where it comes in: helping homeowners through the entire process.

Massachusetts currently has some of the most generous home energy rebates it has ever offered. This is great news for homeowners who need a new system and have been putting it off.

Through Mass Save, the state's energy-efficiency program, homeowners can receive substantial rebates for upgrading to a heat pump. Rebates can range from a few hundred dollars to $8,500, depending on qualifications. Mass Save also offers 0% interest financing through its HEAT Loan program, along with free home energy assessments that identify exactly what upgrades make sense for a home.

The Rebate Process Is Intimidating for a Lot of People, but Townsend Makes It Easy

Most homeowners find the paperwork required for a rebate to be overwhelming and complicated. Between eligibility documentation, contractor forms, and an online portal that, frankly, isn't especially user-friendly, many homeowners get halfway through the process, get frustrated, and then give up, missing out on free money.

This is exactly why Townsend created a dedicated rebate team, led by its rebate specialist, Melissa Clark. Melissa manages the entire rebate process for customers from start to finish. She will also help customers secure financing if needed. She gathers documentation, uploads it to the portal, tracks deadlines, and follows up on any missing information so homeowners get every penny of the rebate they're entitled to. Townsend provides hands-on support throughout the entire process, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks and that customers receive the rebate they qualify for.

"Townsend is one of the only companies that will hold the customer's hand through this whole process," says Jimi Letchford, Chief Growth Officer at Townsend. "Most other companies will say, 'submit your paperwork,' and then leave it all to the customer. That means many people are missing out because the process can be complicated. We don't do that; we have Melissa."

Common Myths That Keep People from Applying for Rebates

The first myth is that homeowners have to completely replace their oil or gas furnace to qualify for a rebate. They don't. Homeowners can install a heat pump as a supplement to an existing fossil fuel system and still receive a rebate. The rebate for a supplemental system is typically a smaller tier than the rebate for a whole-home heat pump conversion, but it's still available.

The second common myth customers believe is that a heat pump can't handle a New England winter. That was true of older systems, but it isn't true anymore. Modern heat pumps are built to perform efficiently even on the coldest days.

Advertised rebate amounts can often be misleading. The rebate a homeowner qualifies for may differ depending on the size and type of system installed. Townsend's sales team is trained to walk customers through this process up front, so there are no surprises once the paperwork is submitted.

The Best Time to Start Is Before You Need To

For homeowners considering financing a project, the process should start with a home energy assessment. That assessment audits the entire home and produces a set of recommendations that becomes the roadmap for the project and the homeowner's rebate eligibility. Most often, the general recommendation is a heat pump paired with some weatherization.

Waiting until a system fails in the dead of winter takes away from planning time. Homeowners who start the process well before winter have time to get an assessment, secure financing, and build a clean rebate application with Townsend's assistance.

"Savings Ready is Townsend Ready, because Townsend does the work for its customers."

The equipment, the financing, and the rebates are all available. What gets in the way most often is the paperwork, a problem Townsend has solved for its customers. For more on Townsend's rebate assistance, visit townsendtotalenergy.com/about/rebates.

About Townsend

Founded in 1931, Townsend is a fourth-generation, family-owned and operated company serving residential and commercial customers throughout Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Maine. The company provides fuel delivery, HVAC installation and service, and electrical services, and is proud to serve customers across New England. For more information, visit www.townsend360.com or call 978-717-0490.

data.title: imogene + willie and Wrangler® Launch Landmark Collaboration Rooted in American Denim Heritage
data.description:
imogene + willie and Wrangler® Launch Landmark Collaboration Rooted in American Denim Heritage

Drawing from Wrangler's iconic archive, the collection is reimagined through imogene + willie's distinctly American approach to craftsmanship and making.

For more than 75 years, Wrangler® has helped define American denim. For imogene + willie, that legacy has been a source of inspiration and admiration since its founding in 2009. Built on a shared reverence for the craft and heritage of American denim, the two brands have partnered on a landmark collection that pairs Wrangler's defining place in denim history with imogene + willie's enduring commitment to domestic manufacturing.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260926678904/en/

Wrangler x imogene + willie collection

To bring this collaboration to life, Wrangler opened its historic archives to the imogene + willie team, granting access to original patterns, including the iconic 1964 vintage 10MWZ, along with its coveted supply of Cone Mills White Oak deadstock selvedge denim. Beyond White Oak, the collection also incorporates fabrics developed with Mount Vernon Mills, the last remaining large-scale denim mill in the United States, alongside original labels, pocket flashers, packaging, and visual assets that were thoughtfully reimagined through imogene + willie's distinctive design process.

"This project began with a deep and enduring admiration," says imogene + willie co-founder Carrie Eddmenson. "Wrangler's story has shaped our own. The blue jean they introduced became a blueprint not just for style, but for integrity, craft, and American identity. Made in America has always been a core tenet of who we are, and who Wrangler helped inspire us to become. For them to join us here at home feels more like a ceremony than a collaboration."

The collaboration was an invitation for imogene + willie to step inside one of the richest histories in American denim. Wrangler entrusted imogene + willie with the freedom to explore decades of craftsmanship, design, and tradition. In return, imogene + willie approached the collection with their steadfast desire to put American materials and manufacturing first, with every detail being considered in pursuit of creating something truly special.

"This partnership allowed us to explore our roots through a fresh lens, resulting in pieces that honor the true artistry behind every single stitch," says Joe Broyles, Vice President of Global Collaborations & Chase at Wrangler. "It is a celebration of our shared passion for preserving denim heritage and an homage to the uncompromising quality that has always defined our brand."

"When you bring together Wrangler's remarkable history with a shared commitment to preserving American craftsmanship, you create something that's larger than a single collection," says K.P. McNeill, CEO of imogene + willie. "From the very beginning, we believed this project should honor the people, mills, and makers who continue to keep this craft alive. We hope it reminds people that extraordinary products can still be built through that level of intention and collaboration."

To highlight the depth of the collaboration, the collection will be released in three distinct drops:

Drop 1 (September 26): The launch begins with selvedge denim in Wrangler's vintage 10MWZ model crafted from Cone Mills White Oak deadstock fabric.

Drop 2 (October 24): This release features Wrangler's signature broken twill across jackets, shirts, and jeans developed with Mount Vernon Mills, the last remaining large-scale denim mill in the United States. Plus vintage-inspired graphic tees, sweatshirts, and accessories.

Drop 3 (November 7): The partnership concludes with additional deadstock denim styles in original western cuts, including a rigid western snap.

Starting Sept. 26, customers can shop the first drop of the collection on Wrangler.com, and in-store and online at imogeneandwillie.com. The collection will range in price from $48 to $350.

ABOUT IMOGENE + WILLIE

imogene + willie is a Nashville-based denim and apparel brand founded in 2009 and built on a simple goal: to make garments that transcend simple trends, and to do it all in the United States. What began as a labor of love, making jeans from start to finish in a converted 1950s Nashville gas station, has grown into a small-but-mighty team producing a diverse collection of denim, outerwear, graphic tees, loungewear, and more, all still made domestically today. In addition to their Nashville flagship store, I+W has expanded their operation to include in-house screen printing, a sewing room in Los Angeles, and a second home in Austin, Texas. To learn more, visit imogeneandwillie.com.

ABOUT WRANGLER

Wrangler®, of Kontoor Brands (NYSE: KTB), has been an icon in authentic American style for more than 75 years. With a rich legacy rooted in the Western lifestyle, Wrangler is committed to offering superior quality and timeless design. Its collections for men, women, and children look and feel great, inspiring all those who wear them to be strong and ready for everyday life. Wrangler is available in retail stores worldwide, including flagship stores in Fort Worth and Greensboro, department stores, mass-market retailers, specialty shops, top western outfitters, and online. For more information, visit Wrangler.com.

data.title: University of Phoenix research recognized as Editor's Choice paper by Glacies
data.description:
University of Phoenix research recognized as Editor's Choice paper by Glacies

University of Phoenix research recognized as Editor's Choice paper by Glacies

PR Newswire

PHOENIX, Sept. 26, 2026

Environmental science education study examining storytelling and AI-supported learning receives Editor's Choice distinction

PHOENIX, Sept. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- University of Phoenix announces that the peer-reviewed study, "Harnessing AI, Virtual Landscapes, and Anthropomorphic Imaginaries to Enhance Environmental Science Education at Jökulsárlón Proglacial Lagoon, Iceland," has been recognized as an Editor's Choice paper by Glacies.

Published in February 2026, the study explores how character-driven narratives and human-centered artificial intelligence can support adult learners in understanding complex environmental science concepts. The article was authored by Jacquelyn Kelly, Ph.D., associate dean, College of General Studies; Dianna Gielstra, Ph.D., full-time faculty, Environmental Science Program, College of General Studies; Tomáš J. Oberding, Ph.D., full-time faculty, Environmental Science Program, College of General Studies; Jim Bruno, MBA, associate dean, College of Business and Information Technology; and Stephanie Cosentino, MAEd, senior instructional designer, University of Phoenix.

The recognition highlights research conducted within the University's "Principles of Environmental Science," a course serving non-science majors and adult learners. The study examined the use of character-driven storytelling and AI-generated imagery, developed through a human-centered, faculty-guided design process, to help learners engage with scientific concepts and environmental systems.

"The cryosphere plays a critical role in Earth's environmental systems, yet it is a topic often reserved for advanced scientific study. We wanted to create an accessible entry point into this important science. By bringing together immersive virtual landscapes, narrative storytelling, and human-centered AI, we designed a learning experience that helps adult learners see scientific processes as connected, dynamic, and relevant to the world around them."

Innovative approaches to environmental science education

The study describes how the course uses a storybook-inspired format to introduce environmental science concepts through approachable characters and narratives. Characters such as Nico Nitrogen, Remi Rock and Waverly Water personify scientific processes and cycles, providing adult learners with accessible entry points into complex topics while maintaining alignment with course learning outcomes.

"Recognition by Glacies as an Editor's Choice paper reflects the quality of scholarship being produced by our faculty and academic leaders," said Briana Houlihan, MBA, dean, College of General Studies. "Research such as this demonstrates how innovative instructional approaches can help make complex scientific concepts more engaging and accessible for adult learners while contributing to broader conversations about teaching, learning and technology's role in design."

Researchers reported positive student responses to the instructional approach. According to the study, 87.1% of surveyed students reported enjoying the anthropomorphic narratives, while 82.0% agreed the approach reinforced systems thinking. Qualitative feedback indicated that narrative framing and consistent visuals helped learners visualize relationships among Earth systems and communicate scientific concepts more effectively.

Supporting engagement among adult learners

The authors present the work as a practical model for courses serving non-science majors and working adults. By combining narrative-based learning experiences with carefully guided AI-supported visual development, the approach seeks to make abstract scientific concepts more approachable while supporting learner engagement and understanding.

The Editor's Choice recognition by Glacies acknowledges the study's contribution to ongoing conversations about environmental science education, instructional design and the thoughtful application of artificial intelligence in higher education learning environments.

Access the study

"Harnessing AI, Virtual Landscapes, and Anthropomorphic Imaginaries to Enhance Environmental Science Education at Jökulsárlón Proglacial Lagoon, Iceland" is available online through Glacies at https://doi.org/10.3390/glacies3010003.

About University of Phoenix
University of Phoenix is Built for Real Life. 50 Years Strong. The University innovates to help working adults enhance their careers and develop skills in a rapidly changing world through flexible online learning, relevant courses, academic AI pillars, and skills-mapped curriculum for associate, bachelor's and master's degree programs. Active students and alumni have access to Career Services for Life® resources including career guidance and tools. For more information, visit phoenix.edu.

HONG KONG, Sept. 26, 2026

City's Hottest Celebrities Pack First VIP Session of Over 1,000 Guests; Brand Teases Brand-New Comic Launch Next Year

HONG KONG, Sept. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Global music star Jackson Wang, serving as Creative Director of the original fantasy IP "Under the Castle" (UTC), has joined forces with Ocean Park's Halloween Fest 2026 for a major cross-over collaboration. Perfectly blending dark, thrilling aesthetics with an immersive story world, the partnership delivers the high-impact Under the Castle horror experience. On 24 September, a grand VIP-exclusive event was held — marking UTC's first landing in Hong Kong, China, following previous offline experiences in Shanghai, China, Singapore and Bangkok, Thailand. The star-studded gathering welcomed more than a thousand celebrities, popular idols, KOLs and media guests, challenging their courage and sending adrenaline levels soaring as the venue erupted in excitement.

On the night, under the witness of VIPs and media, Creative Director Jackson Wang — dressed in a full set of exclusive limited-edition UTC attire — together with Co-founder Zhang Quan and other officiating guests, launched the lighting ceremony. UTC is an otherworldly experience interwoven with light and darkness. The guests of honor lifted the green crystal curse, and atmospheric green lights illuminated the entire venue, spreading from the first lamp across the UTC zone and officially opening the event.

In addition to media guests, numerous artists and friends also attended, creating a glittering star-studded atmosphere. Among those present were Jeffrey Ngai, Feanna Wong, 903 DJ Sammy Leung, Eliza Sam, Grace Chan, COLLAR members Marf and Day, 193@ERROR, Viann, Hei Kong, BlueS, Nicolas Yeung, Matthew Lau, Mak Miu-sing and his wife Tong Yi, Torres Pit, Cheng Man, Taiwanese artists Lin Shi-ya, Pessa Sakabe, Lin Jiao-kuang, Lam Tak-shing, Boris, ANSONBEAN, Renci Yeung, WinWin Yeung, Killer, Huo Ge, Snow, Chiu Wing-yiu, KALF, Zeno Koo, Jess Lo, Meaning Wong, Hung Cho-sing, and choreographer Kenya, among others. Over a thousand VIPs explored the "Under the Castle SnapGenie Spot," "Under the Castle Into the Mirror," "Under the Castle Phantom Lounge," and the "Dark Ride: Bumper Blaster," joining various spooky characters to experience the rush of soaring adrenaline and centrifugal thrills, while also taking on the "Nightmare Game Booth" to win limited-edition themed prizes.

Beyond the electrifying horror experiences that lit up the night, Creative Director Jackson Wang of UTC also appeared at the event and shared with the media the concept design behind this UTC Zone as well as future development plans. He revealed that a brand-new comic will officially launch next year. Popular characters PUMPKIE and SPOOKIE will continue as the main protagonists, with new characters introduced simultaneously. The overall comic style will undergo a significant transformation. The new story will break free from traditional frameworks and revolve around a highly philosophical core question: "what is happiness?" This marks an important new chapter following the rebrand of Under the Castle.

data.title: Meta turned Muse into a viral hit. Now comes the hard part.
data.description:
By Christine Ji

Meta is quickly racking up downloads for its Muse AI assistant, but the next step for Mark Zuckerberg is getting users to make the agent part of their everyday routines

Meta recently unveiled a new lineup of AI-integrated hardware including new Ray Bans and a keychain-sized Muse Charm.

For the past week, Meta's artificial-intelligence assistant Muse has sat at the top of Apple's U.S. App Store charts.

The widespread popularity of the agent - a fuzzy customizable avatar capable of sending emails, booking reservations, making online purchases and more - has sent shares of Meta (META) on a tear. The stock is up 31% since the beginning of the month.

But in a cutthroat AI ecosystem, no agent or application can afford to get too comfortable. As other companies race to push out new models and products, Meta will need to translate Muse's initial buzz into an everyday consumer habit to stay in the lead. Can the social-media giant shape the next generation of user behavior?

According to a Thursday report from Sensor Tower, Muse has accumulated over 3.4 million downloads across the U.S. and Canada since its Sept. 8 launch. The report also highlighted that Grok Bot, SpaceX's (SPCX) multi-agent platform, has picked up 2.2 million downloads since its August launch. Another AI assistant, Instinct, has risen in popularity recently as well.

Morningstar analyst Malik Ahmed Khan believes that Meta has an unique advantage in growing its Muse platform given its existing distribution with Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. With the exception of Alphabet's (GOOGL) (GOOG) Google, "Meta is the only company that has experience scaling multiple platforms to multi-billion-user levels," Khan told MarketWatch.

Muse gives Meta a direct window into user habits which can help future product development, Khan added. The company has identified nearly 400 "musecases" ranging from auditing unnecessary subscriptions to negotiating parking tickets.

JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth was further encouraged by the company's path forward following Wednesday's Meta Connect 2026 developer conference. Meta announced the third generation of its flagship Ray-Ban smart glasses, its first camera-free audio glasses, lightweight Meta VR glasses and the keychain-sized Muse Charm. All of these devices are compatible with Muse through voice capabilities.

"Muse represents the centerpiece of Meta's AI vision," Anmuth wrote, citing Meta's expanding hardware and software ecosystem. Muse is also accessible through an increasing number of third-party connectors such as Walmart (WMT), Instacart (CART), Box (BOX) and Wayfair (W).

"We continue to believe this is the first of many steps to bring tens and potentially hundreds of millions of businesses onto Muse, and form the foundation for monetization," Anmuth said of Muse's e-commerce partnerships.

Meta also needs to prove that AI agents can achieve widespread adoption among everyday people. Muse Charm, a small hardware device that allows users to query Muse without a phone, could help the agent become a seamless part of people's everyday lives.

Muse Charm "gives Meta another access point to its growing AI ecosystem, complementing products such as its AI glasses and its broader suite of apps and service," Counterpoint principal analyst Anshika Jain wrote in a Thursday note. Still, Jain cautioned that its success hinges on offering enough utility to justify carrying an extra device.

There's also the question of security and privacy. In order for an agent to take actions on a user's behalf, it needs access to sensitive personal data such as email accounts, payment credentials and third-party logins.

Security concerns remain an issue for companies across the industry, according to Urday Cheruvu, portfolio manager at Harding Loevner. "I'm not sure the trust is there for anyone, the reason being that this is so early and so new," Cheruvu told MarketWatch.

Meta has taken steps to ensure user privacy. Each user's Muse agent runs in a dedicated computer in the cloud called Muse Secure VM. Meta said it doesn't share any data from Muse with its core ad business. Later this year, Meta plans to roll out Muse Confidential VM, an upgraded security model that encrypts all user conversations and data behind a private key inaccessible even to Meta itself.

For now, Muse usage is "skewed among early adopters," Cheruvu said. But Cheruvu expects Meta to promote different Muse use cases on Instagram Reels and its other platforms, boosting adoption and creating a barrier to entry for competitors.

"Muse is connected to Facebook, WhatsApp and Instagram," Cheruvu said. "It already knows so much...so it can anticipate what you want better."

-Christine Ji

This content was created by MarketWatch, which is operated by Dow Jones & Co. MarketWatch is published independently from Dow Jones Newswires and The Wall Street Journal. 




  (END) Dow Jones Newswires

NEW YORK, Sept. 26, 2026

NEW YORK, Sept. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Expert Consumers has recognized Quay among the best affordable luxury sunglasses options for shoppers seeking designer-inspired styling at prices below traditional luxury eyewear. The latest review highlights the brand's broad selection of fashion-focused frames, including many styles priced under $100, as consumers place greater emphasis on combining appearance, lens features, and accessible pricing.

Best Affordable Luxury Sunglasses:

  • Quay - perfect for shoppers seeking designer-inspired frames, current styling, and useful everyday features without a luxury-level price

The recognition comes as sunglasses increasingly serve two purposes within everyday wardrobes. Eye protection remains an important consideration, while frame shape, proportions, lens color, and finishing details have become major purchasing factors. Expert Consumers found that Quay addresses both priorities with oversized aviators, square frames, narrow silhouettes, shield styles, and polarized options across its collection.

Why Quay Is a Strong Choice for Affordable Luxury Sunglasses

Quay stands out for offering designer-look sunglasses without the markup often associated with luxury labels. The brand places a strong emphasis on recognizable silhouettes, polished finishes, oversized proportions, and practical lens options while keeping many popular styles below $100.

According to the Expert Consumers review, this combination makes Quay particularly relevant for shoppers looking for affordable luxury sunglasses that do not look cheap.

The three featured models show the range available within this category. Each provides a different interpretation of designer-inspired eyewear while remaining within an accessible price range.

What Makes Affordable Sunglasses Look More Expensive?

Expert Consumers notes that an upscale appearance does not depend on price alone. Frame proportions, lens treatments, hardware, material choices, and finishing can influence how sunglasses look when worn.

Quay uses several of these design elements throughout its collection. Oversized lenses create a statement profile, while slim metal frames provide a cleaner appearance. Sculpted square frames offer more structure, and gradient or polarized lenses provide additional visual and functional options.

These characteristics support Quay's position for consumers searching for designer-look sunglasses at more accessible prices.

Which Quay Sunglasses Offer a Designer-Inspired Look Under $100?

Expert Consumers highlights Set List, Talk Nice, and Nevermind as examples of how distinctive silhouettes and finishing details can create an upscale appearance without traditional luxury pricing.

  • Set List is the largest of the three featured styles. The frame combines aviator and shield elements with a flush lens and exposed inner-core detailing. At 148 mm wide with a 53 mm lens height, the model creates a prominent profile. Its regular listed price is $95.
  • Talk Nice provides a narrower alternative. The vintage-inspired cat-eye frame measures 142 mm wide and has a 39 mm lens height. The shape offers a defined upward profile suited to shoppers interested in retro-influenced eyewear. Its regular listed price is $75.
  • Nevermind features a 1990s-inspired oval silhouette with a signature long metal plaque. The lightweight frame is designed for all-day comfort and measures 142 mm wide with a 36 mm lens height. Its regular listed price is $85.

All three models include built-in universal nose pads as well as a case and cloth.

Affordable Luxury Reflects Changing Eyewear Priorities

The affordable-luxury category reflects changes in how consumers evaluate fashion accessories. Shoppers can consider materials, construction, proportions, hardware, fit, and practical features alongside brand name and price.

Sunglasses are particularly suited to this approach because frame shape can noticeably change the appearance of an outfit. Large shield-influenced frames provide a statement look. Narrow cat-eye sunglasses add vintage character, while oval frames offer a slimmer profile influenced by the return of 1990s styling.

The three featured Quay models address each of these preferences. These choices allow consumers to consider color and lens appearance alongside frame shape.

What Should Shoppers Look for in Affordable Luxury Sunglasses?

Expert Consumers recommends considering frame shape, proportions, fit, construction, lens characteristics, and price when comparing affordable luxury sunglasses.

A large frame such as Set List provides more visual presence and coverage. A narrow cat-eye style such as Talk Nice offers a smaller profile with defined shaping. Nevermind provides another compact option through its oval lenses and lightweight construction.

Fit also deserves attention. All three featured models include built-in universal nose pads. Measurements published by Quay can help shoppers compare overall frame width, bridge width, arm length, and lens height before selecting a style.

Price should then be considered alongside these design details. Regular listed prices of $95 for Set List, $75 for Talk Nice, and $85 for Nevermind keep each featured model below the $100 mark.

Quay Recognized for Designer-Look Sunglasses Without the High Price Tag

Expert Consumers recognizes Quay as a strong option among the best affordable luxury sunglasses because of its combination of fashion-focused design, accessible pricing, varied frame shapes, and practical lens choices.

For consumers specifically searching for affordable luxury sunglasses that do not look cheap, designer-look sunglasses without the markup, or stylish eyewear options under $100, Quay offers choices that address each of those priorities.

The full review can be read at the Expert Consumers website.

Quay is a global eyewear brand offering a wide selection of sunglasses and prescription glasses. The company's collections emphasize contemporary design, functional lens features, and pricing that remains accessible to a broad range of consumers. Did Zeta Global Holdings Corp. Insiders Breach their Fiduciary Duties to Shareholders?

PR Newswire

NEW YORK, Sept. 26, 2026

Shareholders are encouraged to contact the firm to discuss their rights and options at no cost or obligation. We would handle any matter on a contingent fee basis, whereby you would not be responsible for out-of-pocket payment of our legal fees or expenses.

Shareholders should contact the firm immediately as there may be limited time to enforce your rights. 

NEW YORK, Sept. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Halper Sadeh LLC, an investor rights law firm, is investigating whether certain officers and directors of Zeta Global Holdings Corp. (NYSE: ZETA) breached their fiduciary duties to shareholders.

If you currently own Zeta stock and are a long-term shareholder, you may be able to seek corporate governance reforms, the return of funds back to the company, a court-approved financial incentive award, or other relief and benefits. Please click here to learn more about your legal rights and options or contact Daniel Sadeh or Zachary Halper at (212) 763-0060 or sadeh@halpersadeh.com or zhalper@halpersadeh.com.

Why Your Participation Matters:

Shareholder involvement can help improve a company's policies, practices, and oversight mechanisms to create a more transparent, accountable, and effectively managed organization, which can enhance shareholder value.

Halper Sadeh LLC represents investors all over the world who have fallen victim to securities fraud and corporate misconduct. Our attorneys have been instrumental in implementing corporate reforms and recovering millions of dollars on behalf of defrauded investors.
